53123.explanation:
SEE DIAGRAM ABOVE

Vertical component velocity Vy = Usin\(\theta\)

Time to reach maximium height = t

V = USin\(\theta\) — gt

But V at maximum height = O

.-. O = Usin\(\theta\) - gt

Hence, t = \(\frac{U sin \theta}{g}\) 

But time for a projectile to reach maximum he is equal to time to return to projection plane

53129.subject: Physics
53129.question_text:
Name one use of 'LASER' in each of the following areas:

(a) communication;

(b) medicine;

(c) security
53129.explanation:
Uses of LASER:

(a) Communication for holograms production, CD, VCD, DVD playing, data transfer, fiber-optic cable and space communication.

(b) Medicine - for welding retina of the eye, cervical cancer surgery, boring holes in the skull, cauterizing blood vessels, testing biological samples, monitoring glucose level in diabetic patient, dentistry, etc.

(c) Security - for guidance system of missiles, aircrafts and satellites, generation of isotopes for nuclear weapons or reactors or enriched uranium production.
